decisions.reason: As a proven extension of the firm's core cardboard display capabilities, this pallet-display tray fits its existing knowledge base and can be refined through in-house design, testing, and R&D, so management would keep it.

Because the online customer portal is relatively distant from the firm's main paper-display competences and there is no clear market success signal yet, absorptive-capacity logic suggests a higher risk that management reallocates resources away from it.

This packaging display solution directly builds on the firm's established know-how and its 2024 German Packaging Award is a strong signal that the firm can recognise, develop, and commercialise it successfully.

The quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display is very close to the firm's established retail-display business, so its existing production, design, and customer knowledge make continued improvement and commercial use likely.
A small cardboard counter display is a highly related product for this firm and fits its narrow but deep display specialisation, making it a natural product to retain and optimise.

Although the large freestanding cardboard information display may require more execution and logistics effort, it still relies on the firm's core 3D cardboard display competences and is therefore likely to be kept.
